app.title: TScert: A Sound Core for TypeScript
app.author: bpierre
app.description: A TypeScript type checker and compiler core that aims to be sound and extensible.
proposed_tests: Compile a small TypeScript program and verify output
Run `tscert --noEmit` on a project with type errors and check error reporting
Benchmark type-checking speed on a medium-sized repo and compare to tsc
